topic: Open WebUI v0.11.4 ships a slim Docker image at about 175 MB
title: Open WebUI Slim: An Honest 89 Percent Shrink
description: Open WebUI v0.11.4's slim Docker image drops the bundled machine-learning stack and pulls at about 175 MB; here is what it drops, what the 89 percent really compares, and the tag swap to switch tonight.
hook_text: Open WebUI's download just shrank eighty-nine percent.
hook_candidates: Open WebUI just shipped itself without the ML stack. (named-contradiction) *DRAFT A
Open WebUI's download just shrank eighty-nine percent. (number-shock) *DRAFT B
Eighty-nine percent smaller, and the registry agrees: 168.31 MB. (number-shock)

Open WebUI v0.11.4 cuts its image to about 175 MB. (number-shock)
You pull Open WebUI in Docker. The pull is the problem. (situation)
The slim image is 168 megabytes. The old slim was 1.44 gigabytes. (number-shock)
Open WebUI doesn't need torch on your disk anymore. (named-contradiction)
Slim Open WebUI, honest catch: no MySQL, no S3, no local voice. (named-contradiction)
One tag suffix tonight and your next pull is seconds, not minutes. (tonight)
narration_full: Open WebUI's download just shrank eighty-nine percent. You run it in Docker next to Ollama, wincing at every pull. Slim drops the bundled machine-learning stack: torch, the neural-network library, speech models, and ffmpeg, a media converter. Installed just in case. Eighty-nine percent is against the last slim, a one point four four gigabyte pull. The standard image is still a one point five four gigabyte download. Slim refuses MySQL or S three storage at boot; voice and PDF reading move outside. Chat through Ollama and nothing changes. Tonight, swap your compose file to the slim tag; your volume keeps every chat. Your next pull is about one hundred seventy-five megabytes of download.
